name: Nahum
author: Nahum.
setting: Nineveh, the Assyrian capital, will fall.
theme: God is slow to anger but will judge oppression.

outline.label: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God
The end of the plot and good news for Judah

christInBook: Nahum 1:15 speaks of the messenger who brings good news and announces peace, which is quoted by Paul about the gospel (Romans 10:15). The justice of God against oppression is satisfied fully in Christ.
howToRead: Nahum is a poem about the end of an empire. Read it as the other side of Jonah: Nineveh repented once, but later returned to cruelty.
